title: The Last Ferry
narration: The ferry ticket listed one more passenger than the boat carried. The captain dismissed the extra name, Samuel Reed, before the engines failed and water entered below. Insurance papers exposed his plan to sink the vessel. Then Samuel climbed aboard, soaked, saying the captain had pushed him overboard before departure. He had listed himself to prove he boarded and transmitted the evidence. For several seconds I could hear nothing except my breathing and the small ordinary sounds around me. Every explanation I tried made the details worse, because each clue had been placed where I alone would find it. I wanted to leave immediately, but doing that would mean abandoning the only proof that any of this had happened. His inspection report was fake: he came because his brother died on the captain's previous ferry.
